notes: Non-ducted economy hood. The guide's parts list covers the 41000 and 41000MX, and model 413004 (30 in., stainless steel) is one 41000 series model. The 41000 motor assembly is part 97011220 (97016135 on the 41000MX); the ducted 40000 and 42000 hoods use a different one, 97012248.

gaps: Light conflict: spec sheet 99041055M says an LED bulb up to 15 W; sheet 99041055K, the parts list (75 W bulb, not included) and the 413004 product page (LED, 75 W max) say 75 W. Each is kept only as its own document says.
The sheets' 120 V, 2.0 A (2850 rpm) rating is for the hood (the 413004 page lists 120 V, 2 A, 240 W for the hood), so v and a are not put on the motor.
Filed under carbon on the strength of the 413004 page (removable combination grease-charcoal filter); the guide only calls it a ductfree filter and does not name the media.
The guide covers the 40000, 41000 and 42000 in one PDF (host label BROAN 403001, form 99042381J); only the 41000 and 41000MX rows are used, on PDF page 8.
method: Broan-NuTone 41000 series spec sheet on broan-nutone.com (Spec_Sheet_3.pdf, doc code 99041055M), linked from the 413004 product page; read as text, identical to the PC Richard copy the researcher used.
Elliott Electric copy of the spec sheet (doc code 99041055K), read as text, for the 75 W bulb wording.

Broan-NuTone economy range hood installation instructions, form 99042381J, hosted by Appliance Factory Parts (137566-2.pdf): PDF pages 4 and 6 (filters, only the 40000/42000 hoods named for the aluminum filter) and page 8 (41000 and 41000MX service parts, rendered and columns checked).
Broan-NuTone product page for model 413004 (Broan 41000 Series Under-Cabinet Range Hood, 30 in. ductless, stainless steel).
Broan-NuTone's current economy quick-start guide has no parts list and was not used.

comps.spec: Fan blade, Broan part 99020287 (parts list key 6, listed for the 41000 and 41000MX series). The 41000 series motor assembly, part 97011220 (key 9), includes this blade, the motor mounting bracket and two locking nuts.
Motor is permanently lubricated and its speed is not to exceed 2850 rpm (spec sheet 99041055M, written for Broan Model 41000).
Ductfree Microtek System I filter, Broan part 97007696 (parts list key 10). The guide says it cannot be washed and lasts up to twelve months with normal use.
Polymeric light lens; spec sheet 99041055M says it accepts an LED bulb up to 15 W, A19, E26 base.
Bulb holder with wires, Broan part 99270987 (parts list key 3). The light lens is part 99110437 (key 4).
Hood body with mitered sides and a hemmed bottom edge, in white, almond, black or stainless steel (stainless only in the 24, 30 and 36 in. widths).
Rocker switches: a two-speed fan switch (key 13) and a light switch (key 14). The parts list gives black 97016970 and white 97016971, each listed as including the other switch.
